notes.title: Railbound v3.50 (May 29th 2025) - Level Editor Open Beta Update
notes.notes:
Hi,

Since we announced that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1967510/view/524211581550067846?l=english]we're working on a level editor for Railbound[/url], we've also been thinking about how to best handle releasing this mode. In the end we decided to release it a bit early so that you, the players, can put your hands on it earlier and help us steer this feature in the best possible direction.

Introducing - the [b]Railbound Level Editor Open Beta[/b]:

[previewyoutube=e7dJJhONntw;full][/previewyoutube]

This new mode is available for everyone who updates the game on Steam to [b]version 3.50[/b] (visible in the bottom-right corner of the main menu). You can access the level editor mode through the button on the left side of the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/ea81ee618d7af8dc24622a5edd0857fd13a448e7.png[/img]

[h2]Playing & sharing[/h2]
When opening the Level Editor mode you'll be greeted by a custom [b]level browser menu [/b]- from here you can check out your own creations (on the "My Levels" tab) or play other people's designs (via "Workshop Levels") tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/db0fc4f19b656e667803aba85a99cdbdb9b042a8.png[/img]
You can find [b]new puzzles[/b] to solve over on the Steam Workshop tab for the game: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1967510/workshop/

Currently you need to restart the game in order to update the subscribed levels list in the main menu; we'll update this behaviour later to make it smoother.

[h2]Designing a puzzle[/h2]
After you press the "Create Level" button in the "My Levels" tab you'll enter the level editing mode. The workflow here is split into four main stages:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/fd7a2c5e5848bfef6621c2c8e2a6df58a6c360d6.png[/img]
In the [b]Design[/b] stage you can determine the size of your puzzle (and modify it later if your plans change), and lay down all interactive parts of a level - locomotives, train cars, switches, immutable rails, stations and more! This mode gives you access to all of the tools we have at our disposal when designing puzzles for the game (it's just that the tools are a bit nicer that what we've used when creating Railbound).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/71e8547141d1882fbdec8b0edacf711ec0d8065d.png[/img]
At any time during design you can head over to the [b]Decorate[/b] tab and touch some grass, plant some trees, set up a bunch of buildings, change the visuals on the floor and make your puzzle as pretty (or as unique) as you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/5745a6cb61083567ce602ff216c243cf664d11d4.png[/img]
Once you're happy with your results it's time to [b]Test[/b] your creation - in this mode you need to show that your puzzle can actually be solved before being able to share it with the world. You'll have unlimited rails at your disposal, but when sharing the puzzle with everyone else we're using your result (the amount of tiles you laid) to limit the available rail count for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/44d6bd056deb2bf186e769cbc01e11c1ed4c58b2.png[/img]
The last step is the [b]Publish[/b] stage - name your level, give it a fun description, decide whether to share it with yourself, your friends or all Railbound players - and off you go!

[h2]Few things about the beta[/h2]
As mentioned at the start, this mode is currently in open beta - we've shipped it earlier to get your counsel on which features we should prioritise as we're continuing work on the editor. This feature is very complex and took us a long time to develop, so expect to see some bugs, visual glitches or UI/UX issues as you're playing around with the new tools.

Some of the currently known issues that we're investigating include:
[list]
[*] UI issues with displaying Workshop levels under some circumstances (usually fixed by restarting the main menu or game),
[*] issues with displaying level names in edge cases,
[*] minor UI/UX glitches when using the editor in combination with some of the accessibility features,
[*] etc.
[/list]
We hope you'll have a lot of fun with the level editor - if you run into any problems feel free to share them on our Steam Community forum, through [url=https://discord.gg/afterburn]our Discord[/url] or via e-mail (railbound@afterburn.games).

[h2]Wrapping up[/h2]
Railbound was also featured during today's [url=https://thinkygames.com/direct/]Thinky Direct[/url] and will be taking part in the [url=https://www.cerebralpuzzleshowcase.com]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url] from [b]May 29th till June 5th[/b] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CozyFamilyFriendlyGamesCelebration2025]Cozy & Family-Friendly Games Celebration[/url] over the weekend! We've also applied our biggest discount yet (45%) so now's the best time to give Railbound a try if you haven't done it yet.

[i]PS. We've also just launched a big update to our latest game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2848800/Pup_Champs/]Pup Champs[/url] - check it out if you haven't seen it yet :)[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2848800/Pup_Champs/

notes.title: Railbound Level Editor arrives later this year!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/9b2fac1232d50b7798085bd31ca9993bc7e1cd1d.jpg[/img]

This one has been [i]by far[/i] the most requested feature we've kept receiving ever since Railbound launched back in 2022, but we can finally tease that we've been quietly working on a [b]level editor[/b] for the game since late last year.

It was a challenge for a number of reasons - the amount of UI/UX work involved, platform-related difficulties, the distance from original release making it less likely that people will use this feature enough - but thanks to player feedback and all the positive reviews the game has gotten, we decided to give it a try.

[previewyoutube=n1vuhoK3m38;full][/previewyoutube]

Railbound's level editor will arrive [b]later this year[/b], giving players tools to design their own puzzles, decorate them as they see fit, and share their creations with other people (as long as it's solvable). We're still working on the details of how everything works, so bear in mind that everything in these screenshots and videos is subject to change (for the better, hopefully!).

At the moment we're planning to launch the editor in a [b]public beta, exclusively on Steam[/b] in the coming months. We look forward to seeing what you manage to come up with once it's available. If you're interested in checking the editor out before everyone else, [url=https://discord.gg/afterburn]join our Discord[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/fef60d57c54a2a6b0dc09f346baff8f27c92cbbc.jpg[/img]

[b]PS.[/b] You can also [url=https://afterburn.games/sendy/subscription?f=354yi0M23wAy4L763GL4d0z1q3B34px7gkpejjfd40S892dfloEHW3v8iRXzXLVjuZ4A]sign up for our newsletter[/url] since we sometimes announce stuff like the level editor there earlier :)

[b]PPS.[/b] If you haven't had the chance yet, check out the new demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978840/Pup_Champs_Demo/]Pup Champs, our new upcoming game[/url] that we also plan to release this year!

notes.title: Nominate Railbound for Steam Awards 2023 - Labor of Love
notes.notes:
Dear Railbound Enthusiasts,

As we journey together through the enchanting world of Railbound, a special occasion beckons during the Steam Autumn Sale - the Steam Awards. It's a celebration not just of games, but of communities and the shared experiences they foster. We're setting our sights on the "Labor of Love" category.  Here's a look at how Railbound has grown, thanks to your unwavering support!

[h3]By The Numbers:[/h3]
Started with: 150+ levels across 8 worlds
Now featuring: [b]240+ levels [/b]in 12 diverse worlds

[h3]Highlights of our journey:[/h3]

[b]More Than Just Puzzles - Railbound v1.21 (Petting Update) - Dec 1st 2022[/b]
Adding a touch of warmth with pettable dogs and implementing a requested colorblind mode for an inclusive experience.

[b]New Challenges Unveiled - Railbound v2.0 (Semaphore Update) - Feb 3rd 2023[/b]
Introducing over 30 new levels, ancient-themed worlds, and the semaphore mechanic.

[b]Optimized for Portability - Railbound v2.02 (Steam Deck Verified Update) - Mar 9th 2023[/b]
Ensuring Railbound runs smoothly for our players on-the-go, making puzzle-solving more accessible than ever.

[b]First Anniversary - Railbound v3.01 (Birthday Update) - Sep 6th 2023[/b]
Celebrating our first year with 40 new levels, featuring levels with two locomotives, and new gameplay mechanics,

[b]A Community Triumph: 1,000+ Overwhelmingly Positive Reviews - Nov 6th 2023[/b]
Your feedback has been our guiding star, helping us shape Railbound into a game that resonates with each of you.


[h3]Special Autumn Sale Offer:[/h3]
In celebration of our nomination and to thank you for your support, Railbound is available at a special discount during the Steam Autumn Sale!

Every milestone we've achieved has been possible because of you, our incredible community. If Railbound's journey resonates with you, we would be honored to receive your nomination for the "Labor of Love" award.

With gratitude,
The Afterburn Team

notes.title: Railbound v3.01 (Sep 6th 2023) - Birthday Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/4853dc13575f857956242b7bf37d38de69e7437c.png[/img]

Railbound released exactly one year ago - and to celebrate we've got a big update for all of you!

There are 40 new puzzles to solve across two new worlds - [b]World 11 and World 12[/b]. We've also got a brand-new twist on the existing Railbound formula - all of the new levels feature [b]two locomotives[/b] and separate sets of train cars which you need to connect to the right place in the right order. It was a mechanic that we conceived at an early stage, cut from the original scope of the game because of time constraints, but could now revisit in this update... and honestly, it's a lot more fun and challenging than we originally expected! We hope you have a great time playing around with these new puzzles.

Railbound and all of our other games will also be discounted from September 6th (from 10AM PT) till 20th, so check them out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/4324595d24ef0f8464f7c93e047fa0753ffd9b9b.png[/img]

notes.title: Railbound v2.0 (Feb 3rd 2023) - Semaphore Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/37afdd579f0f33729d1dccf6ed48f9ceca81b427.png[/img]

Update 2.0 for Railbound is available now! We hope you have a great time with this free content patch as our team worked really hard on making it happen :)

We have added [b]over 30 new puzzles[/b] (bringing the total number to 200+) across two new worlds - World 9 and World 10 - which have an ancient theming to them. As announced back in September, there's an all-new mechanic - [b]semaphores [/b]- that allows you to decide how to delay cars in order to avoid crashes. You can also expect new story postcards and two new music tracks composed by a friend of ours.

World 9 was specifically designed to have a gentler difficulty curve for those players who haven't played Railbound since the launch in September - enjoy these lighter puzzles and warm up before World 10 throws you some of the most head-scratching levels in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/45f2e7570d73780b047230db974c2b27ef2aefac.png[/img]

[i][b]Patch notes for Railbound v2.0:[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Added new worlds - World 9 and World 10,[/b]
[*] [i]>    These are set in a new, ancient-themed region![/i]
[*] [i]>   Together there are over 30 new puzzles to solve, with 200+ levels total in the game![/i]
[*] [b]Added a new mechanic - semaphores![/b]

notes.title: Railbound v1.21 (Dec 1st 2022) - Petting Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thanks for your patience. Without further ado, here's info on [b]update v1.21[/b]!

[h3]Can you pet the dogs? Yes![/h3]
First off, this patch introduces a feature that we originally wanted to release at launch - [b]petting pups[/b]! Now, when viewing story art, you can use the cursor to scratch our in-game mascots :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/4f0bf573bda7a29743f56df1d0f9a8bd807b56ca.gif[/img]

[h3]World # - new home for sandbox levels[/h3]
We have also finally gotten around to whipping World 8 into shape - all [b]bonus levels from World 8 were moved into a new, separate [i]"World #"[/i][/b]. This should alleviate confusion that some players had regarding “sandbox” levels (puzzles that contained more rails than you actually needed for completion).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/fd95b01dabed663d5968ad5b425038dbc8cd2fed.jpg[/img]

[h3]World 8 - brand-new puzzles[/h3]
That made World 8 feel a bit barren, so we went in and added [b]11 new puzzles[/b], bringing the [b]total number of levels in the game to 170[/b]. We’ve also made some tweaks to the structure of World 8 to make it feel a bit better for first time players by [b]moving mainline levels to the bonus section[/b] - this should have no impact on your save files, but you might see levels like 8-7A as completed and 8-7 as unplayed (because we swapped them around).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/f2c946c048446c20acc8fca322cdc671e794561a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Colorblind mode - out now![/h3]
Also, we’re finally ready to release [b]colorblind mode[/b]! We promised this feature back in September but ran into some last-minute issues with it; but fortunately, it’s now ready for prime time. Enable it in Settings > Accessibility!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286529/ee26a66f1cd3e530f6980c177abb492b0de87566.png[/img]

We all hope that you enjoy this update :) 

Cheers,
[i]- Luke and the Afterburn team[/i]

[i]P.S. You might be a bit surprised that it's already at v1.21, since earlier in November we announced v1.20. The reason for this is because we locked down development on v1.20 in mid-November to make it in time for the game's launch on Nintendo Switch; but since then, we found some additional improvements that we rolled into release on non-console platforms. TL;DR - enjoy these additional fixes that will come to Switch at a later date.[/i]

notes.title: Railbound v1.10 (10 Oct 22) - Stability Update
notes.notes:
[b]Update v1.10[/b] introduces some major under-the-hood changes as well as what we hope to be a permanent solution for some bugs we’ve been struggling with since release.

[h2]Patch notes for Railbound v1.10:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed crashes related to shadow mapping on certain devices,[/b]
[*] [i]> We’ve finally figured out what plagued certain Android (Samsung S10 and others) and PC (laptops with Intel HD Graphics cards) devices and devised a fix for it,[/i]
[*] [i]> For those interested, we strongly assume it was related to sampling oversized shadowmap textures via bilinear filtering using SampleCmp; once we tweaked the shaders it got better,[/i]
[*] [i]> After this update [b]PC players should no longer need to switch to the [intelfix] branch[/b] or use the Focus Mode in order to be able to play the game,[/i]
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Fixed Steam Deck input issues,[/b]
[*] [i]> Now you should be able to play the game using regular controls without issues,[/i]
[*] [i]> The issue was caused by two independent problems - one was related to our code that checks for whether a device supports touch and defaults to that input method if possible, and the other was the fact that mouse input (triggered by RS and the right touchpad) counted as a gamepad interaction,[/i]
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Reworked the level decoration system,[/b]
[*] [i]> On the surface everything should look the same, but on the inside, we’ve revamped the way we store decorations - instead of Prefab Variants we now keep that information in Serialized Assets,[/i]
[*] [i]> Thanks to that we’ve been able to [b]decrease the game’s size by 30MB on all platforms[/b] (that’s roughly 15-30% depending on the platform!) and give ourselves an option to reduce loading times in future patches![/i]
[/list][list]
[*] Improved directional input responsiveness in level select / game,
[*] Fixed being able to see a grey skybox on some levels in World 8,
[*] Fixed wrong hint overlay in the hidden level,
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of Railbound and we hope this update helps you enjoy the game even more. We've got more stuff planned for 2022, so stay tuned :)

[i]- Luke from Afterburn[/i]

notes.title: All I want to do is put down little rails to help these little trains get home in this delightful little puzzle game
notes.notes: I now live for the victorious choo choo that signals the end of a level in Railbound. Sometimes I get it in 30 seconds: on my first try I see just how to place a few pieces of track to connect two marooned train cars to the waiting locomotive in the right order, and choo choo, we're off to the next puzzle. Sometimes that locomotive toot is a hard-earned reward for 10 minutes of smashing my little train cars into each other, drawing and erasing and drawing train tracks 50 times until I find just the right path... Read more.

notes.title: Next Fest demo coming next week!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42290292/225d5fea0bdc74b29e6ef63ef2d573a09a72f1e2.jpg[/img]


We hope that you enjoyed our current Railbound demo, because it's about to change a bit! (again!) From [b]June 13th till 20th [/b]we're participating in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]Steam Next Fest[/url] - a celebration of demos for upcoming games!

And we can't think of a better way to celebrate than by launching an [b]updated version of the Railbound demo[/b]! In the new version you can expect a bunch of changes, including:

[list]
[*][b] five brand-new levels[/b] for you to try out - including a new mechanic,
[*] [b]an updated input system[/b] that should make rail-bending easier (we hope!),

[/list]

This means that you only have [b]until June 12th to check out the current levels before they're gone for good[/b]! (but will return in the full version...)

As always, we're super grateful to everyone who tried out the demo so far and we hope you'll check out these new puzzles & leave us feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/afterburn]our Discord[/url] and via the updated survey available in the game's main menu!
